```{r}
# 1. Install gert if you don't have it
if (!requireNamespace("gert", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("gert")

# 2. Pull the changes from GitHub to fix the non-fast-forward rejection
gert::git_pull(remote = "origin")

# 3. Push your committed Quarto document up to GitHub
gert::git_push(remote = "origin")
```

```{r}
# 1. Install usethis if you don't have it already
if (!requireNamespace("usethis", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("usethis")

# 2. Configure your Git identity globally
usethis::use_git_config(
  user.name = "daltonkeeley-oss", 
  user.email = "daltonkeeley@gmail.com"
)
```

```{r}
# Pull the blocking changes from GitHub
gert::git_pull(remote = "origin")

# Push your Quarto document to your repository
gert::git_push(remote = "origin")
```

```{r}
gert::git_status()
```

```{r}
gert::git_add(c("README.md", "SOCI 502"))  # Or replace with the exact file names printed by git_status()
```

```{r}
gert::git_log(max = 3)
```

```{r}
gert::git_push(
  remote = "origin", 
  refspec = "refs/heads/main:refs/heads/main", 
  force = TRUE
)
```


